mapper.select: SELECT ii.*, cu.website, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.province,''), COALESCE(p.city,''), COALESCE(p.district,''), COALESCE(p.detail_address,'')) AS company_address FROM interview_invitation ii LEFT JOIN company_users cu ON ii.company_id = cu.id LEFT JOIN position p ON ii.position_id = p.id WHERE ii.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY ii.interview_time DESC

SELECT ii.*, cu.website, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.province,''), COALESCE(p.city,''), COALESCE(p.district,''), COALESCE(p.detail_address,'')) AS company_address FROM interview_invitation ii LEFT JOIN company_users cu ON ii.company_id = cu.id LEFT JOIN position p ON ii.position_id = p.id WHERE ii.student_id = #{studentId} AND ii.status = #{status} ORDER BY ii.interview_time DESC
